originalTitle: US stocks: SpaceX quarterly revenue surges in debut results on strong growth in its Starlink business
simplifiedContent: SpaceX recently shared its first quarterly financial results since going public, and its revenue increased by 92% thanks to the success of its Starlink business and AI projects. This means the company made a lot more money than it did in the same period last year. However, despite this growth, SpaceX still lost money overall because it's spending a lot on new infrastructure and future projects. This news is important because it's being closely watched by investors, especially since a "lock-up" period is about to end, which could affect the company's stock price. The strong revenue growth is a positive sign, but the net loss and upcoming lock-up expiration may impact investor confidence.

originalTitle: US stocks: Dow, S&P 500 close at record highs as AI earnings impress, oil prices tumble
simplifiedContent: Here's what's happening in the stock market: the main US stock indexes, the Dow and S&P 500, just reached their highest levels ever. This is because many companies, especially those working with artificial intelligence like Palantir and Caterpillar, did better than expected and made a lot of money. At the same time, oil prices fell, which helps the economy, and there's hope for a peaceful end to the conflict in Iran, making investors feel more positive. As a result, the stock market is doing very well, with many companies earning more than people thought they would. This is a good sign for the economy and for people who have invested in the stock market.

originalTitle: US Treasury yields fall as oil retreats on Iran deal hopes, Fed hike bets ease
simplifiedContent: Here's what's happening in the stock market: the interest rates on US government debt (called Treasury yields) went down. This happened because oil prices dropped sharply due to hopes of a deal with Iran, which made people less worried about inflation. As a result, investors think the Federal Reserve (the US central bank) might not raise interest rates as much as they thought, which led to a decrease in Treasury yields. This change in interest rates can affect the overall economy and the stock market. The Treasury Department will soon announce its plans for borrowing, which could also impact the market.

originalTitle: Yen holds most gains as intervention keeps speculators on edge
simplifiedContent: The value of the Japanese yen has gone up and is staying high. This happened because of something called "intervention", which is when a country's government takes action to influence its currency's value. As a result, people who try to make money by guessing which way currency values will go (called speculators) are being cautious and unsure of what to do next. This intervention is keeping them "on edge", meaning they're nervous and not making big moves. The yen is holding onto its gains, which means its value is still higher than it was before the intervention.

originalTitle: Palantir Short Sellers Take $3 Billion Hit After 30% Stock Surge
simplifiedContent: Here's what's happening: the stock price of a company called Palantir Technologies Inc. just went up by 30%. This is bad news for people who had bet against the company, known as "short sellers", because they now have big losses. These short sellers have lost about $3 billion dollars. This matters because it shows that the people who were betting against Palantir were wrong, at least for now, and it could affect how they invest in the future. The sudden surge in stock price has essentially erased all the potential gains short sellers had made so far this year.

originalTitle: CBOT grains, soybeans fall as oil drops on Iran hopes
simplifiedContent: The price of grains and soybeans on the Chicago Board of Trade (CBOT) went down. This happened because the price of oil also dropped. The oil price fell due to hopes of a resolution with Iran, which is a major oil-producing country. When oil prices go down, it can make grains and soybeans less expensive to transport, which can lead to lower prices for these commodities. This price drop may be important for investors who buy and sell grains and soybeans, as it could affect their investments.
